title: Service Recovery: Billing-Error Apology on Reference-Testing Cancellation Fees
content:
Where a Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Esoteric Reference Testing class has already had a charge corrected, an apology amount is subtracted from its reference-testing cancellation handling fee.

**Clause.** When the accession carries a credit with the reason *billing correction*, **5.00** is subtracted from the handling fee. When it carries a credit with the reason *duplicate test* and none with *billing correction*, **2.00** is subtracted from the handling fee. An accession with neither has no apology subtracted.

| Credits on the accession | Subtracted from the handling fee |
|---|---|
| At least one billing correction (with or without a duplicate-test credit) | 5.00 |
| A duplicate-test credit, no billing correction | 2.00 |
| Neither | nothing |

**Points of judgement.**

- *Both kinds of credit on the accession.* The billing correction decides: 5.00, not 5.00 plus 2.00.
- *A credit for cancellation before testing only.* That reason is neither of the two, so no apology is subtracted.
